title: One-for-one or one-for-all? Considerations for filovirus vaccine development
content:
by Andrea Marzi

Filoviruses continue to re-emerge in Africa, causing localized public health emergencies. Although vaccination has slowly been implemented for Ebola virus, not for other filoviruses, and holistic approaches are needed to broadly protect against filovirus threats. Filoviruses continue to re-emerge in Africa, causing localized public health emergencies. Vaccination has slowly been implemented for Ebola virus, but not other filoviruses. This Perspective highlights the importance of taking a holistic approach to protect against filoviruses, discussing possible strategies to achieve cross-protection.
author: Andrea Marzi
